message: Just met with Michael Thompson, he's started a new tech venture and is looking to engage with Harvard on a partnership. During his time at Harvard, he was known for his groundbreaking research in machine learning which won the national science fair.

Sarah Clark mentioned she's grateful for the scholarship she received and is considering a significant donation. At Harvard, she overcame financial hardships and was an advocate for affordable education, leading several student-led initiatives for financial aid reform.

Had a great catch-up with alumni at the recent reunion event. Many expressed interest in giving back to the university. Notably, James Peterson, a prominent lawyer, shared his intention to fund a new legal clinic in honor of his mentor, Professor Simmons, who guided him through a difficult wrongful accusation case during his studies.
